thread:
Ava: quick question — in the SLO expander the min/max slider, burst pill, and pool picker are all collapsed into one compact row. Feels cramped on smaller widths. screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/UX/2245
Ravi: I noticed that too. On narrow view the burst chip overlaps the helper text. Might be accessibility issue for VoiceOver.
Noor: can you paste a couple of screenshots? also, is this the compact table or the detail card?
Ava: detail card. i'll drop two screenshots. first is 1280x720 narrow modal, second is iPad split-screen.
design-bot: uploaded 2 files: slo_expander_narrow.png, slo_expander_ipad.png
Maya: quick thought — if we move burst into an inline overflow menu ("More") it reduces visual weight but hides important controls. worried about discoverability.
Leo: technically the burst toggle has a different SLO impact than min/max. We should avoid burying it. Developers need quick access when debugging latency spikes.
Ravi: what if we promote the burst pill to a secondary row when width < 700px? keep min/max + pool on top, burst on next line with same alignment.
Ava: that keeps discoverability and fixes collisions. can we keep compact spacing so it doesn't look like a full new section?
Noor: accessibility nit: when burst moves to second row ensure tab order stays logical: min -> max -> burst -> pool -> save. Keyboard users shouldn't jump around.
Maya: agree. also add aria-describedby on burst explaining "burst increases temporary capacity for short bursts; may increase cost" — short and obvious.
Ravi: copy tweak suggestion: change burst label from "Burst" to "Burst (temp)"? Feels explicit but might be noisy.
Noor: prefer tooltip instead of changing primary label. Tooltip: "Temporary extra GPUs for short windows — can increase cost." Keep main label concise.
Leo: implementation note: CSS can do flex-wrap + gap, but ensure the slider keeps full-width behavior. i'll prototype using `display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; align-items:center;` and a max-width on the slider container.
Ava: can you drop a quick prototype by end of day? if it looks good we'll run a micro usability test with 3 engineers.
Leo: yep — i'll push a branch `feature/slo-expander-wrap` and attach screenshots.
design-bot: created branch feature/slo-expander-wrap
Maya: microtest script suggestion: 1) Set min=1 max=4, 2) enable burst, 3) switch pool. measure confusion/time-to-complete and note any ARIA failures.
Ava: perfect. thanks all. i'll update the product doc and schedule a 20m sync if we need copy decisions.
Ravi: :thumbsup:
Noor: bringing to accessibility review after prototype. cheers.
